package.name: rg6_msgs
package.description:
Messages/services of the DECOMMISSIONED OnRobot RG6 driver (rg6_control, tool-DO path, dropped on 2026-08-19). No running node uses them any more -- the gripper speaks via the GripperCommand action and reports its state as JSON on rg6/bridge_state.
DO NOT DELETE: all five recordings in clearpath/data/recordings/ (as of 2026-07-31) contain /a200_0553/manipulators/rg6/state of type rg6_msgs/msg/GripperState. Without this package they can no longer be replayed -- the package is the type definition of an archive, not dead weight.
